propositions: Single-pass `rebar review` operation is superseded by multi-pass `review-plan` gate from above and deterministic checks from below, and must be safely retired without silently changing caller semantics
The CLI shim must reject unsupported arguments (`--graph` and positional `reviewer_id`) with exit code 2 and helpful messages, rather than accepting and discarding them
The shim must preserve read-only semantics by forwarding `--no-sign=true` to `review-plan`, ensuring bare `rebar review <id>` writes no attestation

Three deprecation rows must be registered (cli, lib, mcp) via the `_deprecations.py` registry using `_scheduled()`, with `via` channels matching site type (stderr for CLI, warning for library, log for MCP)
Internal harness call sites (eval_solver, review_workflows, diff_review_paths) must call a private `_review_ticket_impl()` to avoid double-signaling deprecation warnings
The public `review_ticket` library op must still work and emit a `DeprecationWarning`, while all existing fourteen direct callers remain unedited to prove the impl split preserves behavior
